messages: maya: Heads-up — my docs PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8423) hit preview failures: link-checker + Vale. I can't merge until the preview is green and a reviewer approves. Anyone able to pick this up today? devon: I can take reviews this morning. Give me ~45m and I'll triage the CI output. ci-bot: docs-preview: build failed for PR #8423. link-checker: 3 broken anchors in guides/migrations.md. vale: 2 rule violations (PASSIVE_VOICE, sentence-case rule). See CI details: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/preview/8423 maya: Thanks — quick context: I renamed a header from `API changes` -> `Breaking API changes` which changed the anchor. Also some headings now violate sentence-case format in the migration guide. alex: Can you paste the failing lines? I can patch the anchor refs if it's just a few. maya: Sure — excerpt from link-check output: ``` ./guides/migrations.md: broken link to #api-changes referenced from ./reference/changelog.md: line 78 ./guides/migrations.md: broken link to #upgrade-steps referenced from ./tutorials/upgrade.md: line 12 ./guides/migrations.md: broken link to #deprecated-endpoints referenced from ./reference/compat.md: line 34 ``` maya: Two options: 1) add an explicit anchor near the new header: `` or 2) update the three referring links to match the new header slugs. I prefer updating the references so we don't add raw HTML unless necessary. devon: Agreed. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to update the refs and also fix the sentence-case Vale issues (they're minor: change "API Changes" -> "API changes" in a couple headings). sam: FYI if you update refs, remember our docs slugging uses the header text normalization rules — use `#breaking-api-changes` not `#Breaking API changes` in links. alex: On it. Will push a branch `fix/migrations-anchors-8423` and tag @devon and @maya for review. maya: Awesome. After you push, can someone re-run the docs preview? I don't have permissions to trigger reruns for PR previews. docs-bot: To rerun the preview, comment `@docs-bot rerun-preview` on the PR or run `/docs preview rerun 8423` in this channel. alex: Pushed. tiny diff: updated 3 link targets and adjusted two headings for sentence-case. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8424 devon: Review done, left one nit about link text. Approving after nit fix. maya: Nit fixed. Ready to rerun. @docs-bot rerun-preview ci-bot: docs-preview: rerun queued for PR #8423 and PR #8424. Jobs: link-checker, vale, md-lint. ci-bot: docs-preview: run complete — all checks passed for PR #8423 and PR #8424. ✅ maya: Thanks everyone! I'll merge both after a quick sanity check and try to slot this into the midday merge window so we don't block the release train. :thumbsup: devon: SGTM. If anything else pops up ping me here and we can delay to the next slot. sam: Noted for the release calendar — merged changes will be included in next docs publish cycle at 16:00 UTC. maya: Closing the loop — merged and published. Thanks for the quick turnaround! :rocket:
